Chairs, the compressor, the vacuum pump and the handpieces are serviced by Corwin Equipment Service; ask for Dale Ruiz at 555-0187. A standard call-out is $165 plus parts, and he can usually come within 24 hours. The compressor and suction get a preventive service every April and October. The imaging sensors are not Dale's job; those go to Ferncliff support.
